review.notes: Refused email requests (2026-10-15). Use the removal request form; it asks for your name, property address and contact details.

basis.quote: Utah’s law does not provide a right to correct inaccurate personal data, does not require opt-in consent before processing sensitive data (notice and an opportunity to opt out applies instead), and does not require us to offer an internal appeal process for denied requests.
